## Scope
Describe the smallest public-surface change this PR proposes.

## Contribution lane
- [ ] Public documentation / website
- [ ] Public test / verifier
- [ ] Accessibility / usability
- [ ] Community tooling
- [ ] Other public-only change

## Safety boundary
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private keys, .env files, client data, private control-plane state, provider secrets, or production identifiers.
- [ ] No direct production action is required by this PR.
- [ ] No change relies on privileged self-hosted runners.
- [ ] Any external action remains human-supervised and separately authorized.

## Verification
List the exact local checks run and their results. If none were needed, explain why.

## Evidence
Link the issue, discussion, reproduction, or design note that motivated the change.

## Promotion
This PR proposes source changes only. PR approval, merge, deployment, production authority, and verified live effect are separate states.
